subject: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Next Steps

Hi John —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please confirm or flag edits.

Key pain points you shared:
- High inference cost on current LLM endpoints; token costs + overprovisioning driving spend.
- Latency spikes during peak traffic windows impacting UX (home page search).
- Need control over deployment for PII-heavy queries (data residency and KMS).

Goals we agreed on:
1) Reduce per-token cost by at least 40% for search-related calls while keeping P95 latency under 200ms.
2) Run a 6-week POC on a reserved capacity instance with production-like traffic.
3) Validate end-to-end security controls (KMS integration + audit logs) for procurement approval.

Proposed MAP (high level) — attached as an editable sheet (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0 (by 2027-02-26): Legal & procurement kickoff + NDA/scope confirmation — owner: Samantha Lee (ACME) / Marissa (Redwood)
- Week 1–2 (by 2027-03-12): Provision dedicated test capacity + model onboarding — owner: Redwood infra engs / ACME infra
- Week 3–6 (by 2027-04-02): POC run & performance verification (latency/cost) — owner: ACME app team + Redwood SRE
- Week 7 (by 2027-04-09): Exec review & next-step decision (purchase or extend) — owner: ACME execs / Redwood sales

Stakeholders (as discussed):
- ACME: John Doe (app lead), Samantha Lee (procurement), Raj Patel (security - TBD)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Vivek Kulkarni (Sales Eng lead), Neha Kapoor (CS)

Open items / asks from ACME for kickoff:
1) Confirm procurement timeline and who will sign SOW (Samantha?).
2) Provide a short list of representative query workloads + egress/retention constraints.
3) Any internal compliance checklist we should review in parallel (SOC2, data retention rules).

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP), redwood-pricing-summary.pdf (illustrative pricing for dedicated/reserved capacity).

If that looks right I can convert the XLS into a shared Google Sheet and set the first milestone meeting for next Friday.

Thanks!

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>

Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Next Steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the draft MAP. That aligns with what we discussed. A few notes:

- Procurement: Samantha is correct contact for contracting/PO. She estimates the procurement window could be 3–4 weeks once we have an SOW.
- Security: Raj Patel will need to review the SOC2 artifacts and KMS design. I can intro him after we lock the POC scope.
- Workloads: I attached a short sample (excerpt) of our search workload to the thread (will send separately via SFTP).

On timelines, we'd like to target a POC start the week of Mar 8 if that fits your schedule. Also can you confirm whether dedicated reserved capacity can be isolated to our VPC (we will need that for compliance)?

I'll review the ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx and propose a few edits, but overall looks good. Samantha — can you confirm procurement cadence?

Thanks,
John
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: ACME MAP & Next Steps

Great — thanks John. Quick answers and next steps: 

- POC start: Week of Mar 8 works. Proposed kickoff: Tue Mar 9, 10:00am PT. I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees.
- VPC isolation: Yes — Redwood Dedicated supports customer-managed VPC peering for the POC. Vivek (cc) can confirm technical details and send a short architecture note.
- SOC2 artifacts: Neha can share the SOC2 report + audit log example. Neha — can you drop those into the shared Drive and mark any redactions?

I attached an updated MAP (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestone dates filled in per our convo and a short pricing summary (redwood-pricing-summary.pdf). If ACME can confirm procurement owner and any compliance docs to review, I'll convert the MAP to a Google Sheet and create the shared tracker.

Proposed immediate next steps (actions for this week):
- Samantha: confirm procurement timeline and signer (reply here).
- John: upload representative workload or OK for SFTP transfer.
- Marissa: convert MAP to shared sheet + send kickoff invite for Mar 9.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa

—

Looping in to confirm technical availability and to proactively scope the POC ramp:

- I'll own the infra onboarding for the POC. We can provision a 2-GPU reserved pool to simulate search peak load; if ACME's sample workload shows heavier spikes we can scale to 4 GPUs for the test window.
- I’ll share a short "POC runbook" (one-pager) with network, KMS integration steps, and logging endpoints by EOD Tue.
- On discounts: if ACME commits to a paid proof of value within 30 days after the POC and a 12-month reserved capacity contract, we can offer a 15% committed discount. Marissa — flag for commercial when SOW is ready.
